title: PlasRisk: annotation-based multifeature prioritization of bacterial plasmid sequence clusters
description: PlasRisk is an annotation-based framework that scores bacterial plasmid sequence clusters using ten normalized components with weights derived from random forest, LASSO, and grid search, and assigns frozen A-E priority bands. It supports full, lite, and ordinal scoring modes, accepts isolated plasmids and whole-genome and metagenomic assemblies, and is intended for One Health surveillance prioritization rather than prediction of plasmid transfer or health outcomes.
